verdict.rationale: A live probe found an llms.txt at rocm.docs.amd.com (HTTP 200) that indexes the ROCm documentation, which is the docs ecosystem for the MI325X, so an agent can be pointed at it directly. The file itself notes that the docs are split across multiple projects, and the markdown-rendered doc probe returned 404. Missing for 10: per-page markdown versions of the docs, a single unified llms.txt covering all projects (including instinct.docs.amd.com), first-party documentation of the agent-docs offering, and independent or hands-on corroboration of its usefulness.
